title: X Feed Digest
summary: Gemini 3 Deep Think received a major upgrade (ARC‑AGI‑2 84.6%, HLE 48.4%), while MiniMax M2.5 claims near‑Opus SWE‑Bench performance at much lower cost.
AI builder tooling kept improving: Claude Code’s web upgrade, Subframe’s Design Canvas for UI iteration, and Cloudflare’s markdown response trick to make agent scraping cheaper.

Macro data was mostly calm: January CPI met expectations, but big jobs revisions raised reliability concerns and nudged FedWatch toward a June rate hold; AI hardware is being treated as a safer pocket.
Outside tech, a self‑replicating RNA finding drew attention alongside a feature‑rich open‑source clipboard manager (PasteBar) and the SpaceX Crew‑12 launch to the ISS.

items.title: @Google: Gemini 3 Deep Think benchmarks
items.body: Google says Gemini 3 Deep Think now hits 84.6% on ARC‑AGI‑2, 48.4% on Humanity’s Last Exam (no tools), and a 3455 Codeforces Elo — a broad benchmark jump.

items.title: @cgtwts: MiniMax M2.5 release
items.body: MiniMax’s new M2.5 model reportedly scores 80.2% on SWE‑Bench Verified, runs 37% faster than M2.1, and costs about $1/hr at 100 tokens/sec while staying open‑source.

items.title: @bcherny: Claude Code web upgrade
items.body: Boris Cherny notes that Claude Code on the web just got a major capability boost, strengthening browser‑based coding workflows.

items.title: @IrvinZhan: Design Canvas for agents
items.body: Subframe launched a drag‑and‑drop “Design Canvas” that lets you iterate UI visually while using Claude Code, Cursor, or Codex — aiming to reduce prompt churn for design tweaks.

items.title: @vikingmute: Cloudflare Markdown response
items.body: Tip: sending `Accept: text/markdown` can trigger Cloudflare to auto‑convert pages to Markdown at the edge (with token counts in response headers), making agent scraping cheaper and cleaner.

items.title: @amitisinvesting: January CPI in line
items.body: US January CPI printed 2.4% YoY vs 2.5% expected; core CPI was 2.5% vs 2.5% expected — a calmer‑than‑feared read after the prior day’s volatility.

items.title: @Stocktwits: Jobs revision + FedWatch shift
items.body: Stocktwits highlights that big 2025 jobs revisions raised data‑quality questions and FedWatch odds moved toward a June rate hold; they also noted an AI rotation where software is punished while hardware is treated as a “store of value.”

items.title: @Stocktwits: 2x ETF drawdown example
items.body: A reminder on leverage math: when $U fell ~30.4%, its 2x long ETF $UNX dropped ~60.8% the same day — amplified downside in action.

items.title: @JSheltzer: Origin‑of‑life paper
items.body: A new Science paper reports a 45‑nucleotide RNA molecule that can copy itself — a potential step toward explaining how life could originate.

items.title: @GitHub_Daily: PasteBar clipboard manager
items.body: PasteBar is an open‑source clipboard manager with unlimited history, tagging/boards, syntax‑aware snippets, and local storage/backup; supports Windows and macOS.

items.title: @NASA: Crew‑12 launch to ISS
items.body: NASA went live for the SpaceX Crew‑12 launch carrying Jessica Meir, Jack Hathaway, ESA’s Sophie Adenot, and cosmonaut Andrey Fedyaev to the ISS.
